integrity: The finite arithmetic certificate is reproducible from verify.py using only the Python standard library. The supporting reduction and both explicit four-position words are written in RESULT.md. Scientific novelty has not undergone independent confirmation.
scientific_limitations: Only the fixed length-289 abelian base over F_16 and additions of exactly one disjoint 16-cyclotomic Fourier-zero orbit are classified. No claim about unrelated codes, multiple added orbits, or other alphabet sizes.
title: No single new Fourier orbit raises the distance of the length-289 16-ary abelian code
